title: Annotated Comment File
description: Schema for .comments.json files created by the Obsidian Annotated plugin. Each Markdown note (e.g. note.md) may have a sibling file (note.md.comments.json) that stores all comment threads anchored to lines in that note.

version.description: Schema version number. Incremented when the file format changes in a backwards-incompatible way. Current version: 1.

createdBy.description: Identifier of the plugin version that created this file, in the format 'obsidian-annotated@<semver>'. Used for debugging and future migration logic.

note_path.description: Vault-relative path of the Markdown note this file annotates. Updated automatically when the note is renamed.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this comment file was first created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last write to this file. Updated on every save.

comments.description: Top-level comments anchored to locations in the note. Each comment is the root of a thread — replies are nested inside.

metadata.description: Aggregate statistics recalculated on every save. Consumers can read these without iterating the comments array.

Comment.description: A top-level comment anchored to a line range in the note. Contains an inline replies array that forms the thread.

id.description: Unique identifier. Generated as 'c_' + base-36 timestamp + 5-char UUID fragment.

author.description: Display name of the person who created this comment.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the comment was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last modification to this comment (reply added, resolved, etc.).

location.description: The line range in the note that this comment is anchored to. Updated automatically when lines shift due to edits.

status.description: Whether this comment thread is open or resolved.

resolved_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the comment was resolved. Present only when status is 'resolved'.

resolved_by.description: Author who resolved this comment. Present only when status is 'resolved'.

replies.description: Ordered list of replies forming the thread under this comment. Newest reply is last.

last_activity_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent activity: the latest reply's created_at, or the comment's own created_at if no replies exist. Used for sorting by recency.

content_snippet.description: First 50 characters (trimmed) of the note line at the comment's start_line. Used to relocate the comment when lines shift due to edits above it.

is_stale.description: Set to true when the plugin cannot relocate this comment's snippet in the document. The anchored line may no longer be accurate.

Reply.description: A reply within a comment thread. Replies do not have their own location — they inherit the parent comment's anchor.

id.description: Unique identifier, same format as comment IDs.

author.description: Display name of the reply author.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the reply was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last modification to this reply.

status.description: Status of the reply. Currently always 'open'.

RangeLocation.description: A line range in the note. Lines are 1-indexed, character offsets are 0-indexed. For a comment on a single line, start_line equals end_line.

type.description: Location type discriminator. Currently only 'range' is supported.

start_line.description: First line of the annotated range (1-indexed).

start_char.description: Character offset within start_line (0-indexed). 0 if no sub-line selection.

end_line.description: Last line of the annotated range (1-indexed). Equals start_line for single-line comments.

end_char.description: Character offset within end_line (0-indexed). 0 if no sub-line selection.

CommentStatus.description: 'open' — active and visible by default. 'resolved' — closed, hidden by default in the gutter and sidebar.

Metadata.description: Aggregate statistics for the comment file. Recalculated automatically on every save — never edit these by hand.

total_comments.description: Total number of top-level comments (does not count replies).

authors.description: Deduplicated list of all author names across comments and replies.
